record.oneLiner: A hadrosaur that gave the first evidence of dinosaur parental care.
record.description: Maiasaura was a large duck-billed hadrosaur of Late Cretaceous Montana, discovered at a nesting site during the 'dinosaur renaissance'. Evidence that it fed its young in the nest gave the first proof of parental and social behaviour in dinosaurs — hence 'good mother lizard'.

notableFacts.text: Its nesting colonies gave the first evidence that dinosaurs cared for their young.
'Good mother lizard' — a rare feminine dinosaur name.
